core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hakimah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Wise (feminine)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hakimah corresponds to the Arabic form حكيمة (Arabic root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m); حَكِيمَة (Ḥakīma)). Its core sense is wise, discerning, all-wise. Hakimah is a transliteration of Arabic حَكِيمَة (Ḥakīma) 'wise (feminine)', from the root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m). The source gloss 'wise, judge' mixes the masculine sense into the feminine form; 'wise' is the lexical sense of this form.
